atomic_findings.behavior_claim: At encode/httpx commit b5addb64f0161ff6bfe94c124ef76f6a1fba5254 (released as 0.27.0 per the problem report), get_environment_proxies() classifies the no_proxy entry 'fe11::/16' as IPv6 because is_ipv6_hostname() validates only hostname.split('/')[0], and emits the mount key 'all://[fe11::/16]' with the CIDR suffix inside the brackets; URLPattern then passes that malformed pattern to URL(), which raises httpx.InvalidURL ("Invalid port: ':'") during Client()/AsyncClient() construction before any request. Additionally, URLPattern.matches() as pinned compares only scheme, exact-host regex, and port, so a merely syntactically-parseable CIDR key would not by itself implement network-membership bypass.
atomic_findings.regression_test: With environment no_proxy=fe11::/16, construct httpx.Client() (and httpx.AsyncClient()): expected result is successful construction producing a valid network-aware all:// bypass mount (no InvalidURL). Membership rows: pattern fe11::/16 must bypass http://[fe11::1]/ and https://[fe11:ffff::1]/, and must proxy http://[fe12::1]/, http://fe11.example/, and http://192.168.1.1/. Non-regression rows restate the pinned PROXY_CASES: no_proxy=127.0.0.1 -> {'all://127.0.0.1': None} still bypasses http://127.0.0.1/, ::1 -> {'all://[::1]': None} still bypasses http://[::1]/, localhost still bypasses, no_proxy='*' still yields an empty proxy map, and scheme-, port-, and priority-sensitive behavior from URL_MATCH_CASES/EXPECTED_PRIORITY is unchanged. Uses only the existing public surface (no_proxy env var, httpx.Client/AsyncClient); network-bypass expectation is the problem report's stated intended behavior, not an invented contract.
atomic_findings.residue: When a configuration token embeds non-URL semantics (such as a CIDR network selector) inside a URL-shaped dispatch key, making the key syntactically parseable is insufficient; the dispatch layer must explicitly preserve the embedded selector and evaluate its semantics (e.g., network membership) at match time.
atomic_findings.applicability_predicate: Applies when CIDR or similar selector tokens are encoded into URL-shaped proxy/mount dispatch keys whose matcher evaluates only scheme, host-literal/regex, and port, as in the pinned httpx URLPattern mount mechanism.
exclusions: Does not apply when the downstream URL abstraction is documented to retain and natively match the embedded selector
No claim about dispatch layers other than the pinned excerpt's mount mechanism (get_environment_proxies -> URLPattern -> _transport_for_url)
No cross-project generality, transfer, harvest, rate, compounding, amortization, or waterline claim at B2
